places.name: National Crafts Museum & Hastkala Academy
places.description: A large museum of Indian crafts and handlooms run under the Ministry of Textiles. It runs a Craft Demonstration Programme where invited artisans show their work.

verified.source: Museum's official site (nationalcraftsmuseum.nic.in) event pages, found by web search

places.name: Anokhi Museum of Hand Printing
places.description: A museum of hand block printing in a restored haveli near Amber. Visitors can watch block carving and printing, and try printing themselves.

verified.source: Museums of India listing and other directories, found by web search. TODO-VERIFY: confirm official URL and timings

places.name: Kalakshetra Foundation
places.description: A famous school of dance and music in Thiruvanmiyur, founded in 1936 by Rukmini Devi Arundale. It offers courses and holds performances.

verified.source: Government of India portal (india.gov.in) listing of the official website, found by web search

places.name: DakshinaChitra Heritage Museum
places.description: A living-history museum of South Indian homes and crafts on the East Coast Road, south of Chennai, run by the Madras Craft Foundation. It hosts craft workshops.

verified.source: Incredible India (incredibleindia.gov.in) and Museums of India listings, found by web search. TODO-VERIFY: confirm official URL

places.name: Crafts Council of India – Kamala crafts shop
places.description: The Crafts Council of India supports artisans and holds craft bazaars. Its Kamala shop in Egmore sells handmade work directly linked to craftspeople.

verified.source: Crafts Council of India official site (craftscouncilofindia.in), found by web search
